scope: Full RAM/CPU/FPU, CCR/cache-tag read order and OCBI trace comparisons for large ranges across CCR mode bits 5/7, mixed/outside tags, offsets and FPU banks. Independent read-count, initial CCR read, empty/nonempty trace checks and complete invalidate address list in direct-tag mode. Synthetic tags model hardware reads; callbacks record events and do not implement physical cache or transfer completion.
